ink.description: Default text, structural rule, and dark contrast surface.

line.description: Quiet one-pixel dividers and inactive control borders.

primary.description: The sole brand accent for key actions, selected states, and direction.

primary-deep.description: Hover and pressed state for Primary Blue actions.

sans.purpose: Headings, body copy, controls, and Korean-English content.

mono.purpose: Compact status, indices, code, and technical metadata.

body.purpose: 14px to 17px readable copy with 1.5 to 1.7 line height.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Color and border changes without moving layout.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Show the complete final state immediately.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority in-place action with a square silhouette and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 50px; padding-inline: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary { border-color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue); color: var(--paper); } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--deep); background: var(--deep); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 50px; padding-inline: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary { border-color: var(--line); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--blue); background: #eff6ff; color: var(--blue); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: A labelled native input using the shared control dimensions.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field label { width: fit-content; color: var(--ink); font: 700 13px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--blue); outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A native independent choice with a visible label and square indicator.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px/1.45 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-checkbox input { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 1px 0 0; border-radius: 0; accent-color: var(--blue); } .ds-checkbox input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: A native checkbox exposed as a switch for an immediately applied setting.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px/1.45 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-switch-track { width: 44px; height: 24px; padding: 3px; display: block; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); } .ds-switch-track span { width: 16px; height: 16px; display: block; background: var(--muted); transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track { border-color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track span { background: var(--paper); transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline feedback that communicates status with a title, copy, icon, and semantic color.
components.html:
i

Check this status

Explain the next action briefly and clearly.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top-color: var(--info); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-alert h3, .ds-alert p { margin: 0; } .ds-alert h3 { font: 700 15px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-alert p { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: A flat site header using the official identity and direct destinations.
components.html: LafLabsNoticesDesign
components.css: .ds-site-nav { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); } .ds-site-nav a { color: inherit; font: 650 13px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-site-brand { margin-right: auto; font-size: 18px !important; font-weight: 760 !important; } .ds-site-nav a:hover { color: var(--blue); } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Two mutually exclusive short choices inside one square control.
components.css: .ds-segmented { min-height: 44px; padding: 3px; display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); } .ds-segmented button { min-width: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 700 11px/1 var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Select
components.description: A composite single-value picker for richer option states and keyboard navigation.
components.css: .ds-select-trigger { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-select-trigger:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { border-color: var(--blue); outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A focused, labelled task surface with visible dismissal and bounded internal scroll.
components.html:
Project inquiry

Leave the project context and a way to reach you.
components.css: .ds-dialog { position: relative; width: min(620px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); padding: 48px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font: 720 42px/1.08 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-dialog p { color: var(--muted); font: 400 15px/1.65 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-close { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-dialog-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Peer views with roving keyboard focus and a measured blue active rule.
components.html: Overview content
components.css: .ds-tab-list { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-tab-list button { position: relative; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 16px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 700 13px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-list button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--blue); } .ds-tab-list button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tabs [role="tabpanel"] { padding-block: 24px; }

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Rule-separated progressive disclosure for supporting information.
components.html: We turn product lessons into shared foundations.
components.css: .ds-accordion { border-block: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); } .ds-accordion h3 { margin: 0; } .ds-accordion button { width: 100%; min-height: 58px; padding: 14px 2px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px/1.45 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-accordion button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-accordion > div { padding: 2px 40px 22px 2px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.65 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: A legible product company built from Paper, Ink, Primary Blue, and explicit structure.
narrative.overview: LafLabs public web surfaces use a light editorial system with square geometry, one-pixel rules, restrained motion, and equivalent Korean and English content. Components expose native semantics first, use Primary Blue as the sole brand accent, and avoid invented product claims or decorative complexity.
keyCharacteristics: Paper surfaces and Ink typography with one Primary Blue accent.
Zero-radius controls, one-pixel rules, and no ornamental shadows.
Geist Sans and Pretendard for meaning; Geist Mono for compact technical metadata.
A 1280px shell that stacks complex layouts at 1080px and becomes one column at 720px.
Bilingual copy, visible focus, reduced-motion completion, and honest system states.

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Use Primary Blue for key actions, selection, and direction; reserve semantic colors for real status.

rules.name: Square Structure
rules.body: Use zero-radius geometry and one-pixel rules instead of cards, pills, shadows, or decorative depth.

rules.name: Native First
rules.body: Preserve native controls and semantics, then apply LafLabs visual styling.

rules.name: Verified Content
rules.body: Use official assets and verified product facts; omit unavailable claims instead of inventing them.

dos: Do reuse the published Core UI components when their contracts fit.
Do keep controls keyboard-accessible with visible focus and 44px touch targets.
Do check Korean line breaks and English equivalence at mobile widths.
Do honor reduced motion by showing a complete static state.
donts: Don't add rounded cards, pills, ornamental shadows, or a second accent color.
Don't replace native semantics with div-only lookalikes.
Don't animate padding or layout position on hover.
Don't invent product names, customer stories, metrics, or unavailable assets.
